維基專頁 infobox：released 1989、**recorded August 19 and 21, 1988**、studio A&R Recording NYC、length **50:37**、label Blue Note **B1-91101**、**producer Jack Walrath**。**維基的曲目表只列六首**（到〈Beer!〉為止）＝黑膠原盤形；**編制表也只有六人，沒有 Margitza**。AllMusic 的 Scott Yanow 給四顆星，評語原文：「Trumpeter Jack Walrath's music by the mid-'80s tended to play off of the melodies of tunes and their moods rather than merely following chord changes and predictable patterns. ... Although somewhat overlooked, Jack Walrath is always well worth checking out for he avoids the obvious and his music is full of surprise.」

**Cash Box 1989 年 3 月 11 日 p.28 的 JAZZ PICKS**：「JACK WALRATH: Neohippus (Blue Note **7 9H01**) Witty, well-played set from engaging hard bop writer and tasty trumpeter.」（**目錄號被 OCR 成「7 9H01」，實為 7 91101**，第 509c 條）。**同一格的上一則就是 McCoy Tyner《Revelations》(Blue Note 7 91651)**——本批 a 組那張。

**Billboard 1989 年 4 月 15 日 p.41 的 New Releases**：「JACK WALRATH Neohippus **LP** Blue Note B1-91101/NA **CA** B4-91101/NA」——**只列黑膠與卡帶，沒有 CD 那一欄**。**同一期 p.46 另有一則 Walrath 的專訪短文**：「Walrath's latest release on Blue Note, 'Neohippus' — **an evolutionary descendant of 'Pithecanthropus Erectus,' perhaps?** — hardly runs that risk. It boasts a collection of shapely tunes that are anything but mindless pap. What inspired this emotional effort? '**I like music with balls**,' says Walrath simply.」——**記者把盤名讀成 Mingus〈Pithecanthropus Erectus〉的「演化後代」**，而 Walrath 正是 Mingus 最後一個樂團的小號手。

Ralph Peterson Trio ／ Andrew Hill ／ Rick Margitza**」。**本組五張同時出現在這一版上，是本層引用率最高的一則紙本。**

Records／David Newman appears courtesy of Atlantic Records／Bobby Hutcherson appears courtesy of Landmark Records／Richard Tee appears courtesy of Epic/Sony Records／Ray Charles appears courtesy of CBS Records**」。編制：Lou Rawls（人聲）、**Bobby Watson（中音薩克斯風）**、Howard Johnson（上低音薩克斯風）、David「Fathead」Newman（次中音）、**Jack Walrath（小號、柔音號）**、Robin Eubanks（長號，A1／B3）、Steve Turre（長號）、Richard Tee（鋼琴、電鋼琴、管風琴）、Cornell Dupree（吉他，A1–A4／A6／B2／B3／B5）、Steve Khan（吉他，A5／B1／B4）、Tinker Barfield（貝斯）、Chris Parker（鼓）、Jesse Levy（弦樂組指揮）。**製作 Billy Vera 與 Michael Cuscuna，錄音與混音 Peter Darmi，母帶 Wally Traugott，美術指導與攝影 Carol Friedman，設計 Carlos Cordova 與 John Kosh，內頁文字 Gary G. 維基專頁：1989 年發行，**「Promoted as a jazz album, it was timed to the 50th anniversary celebration of Blue Note Records」**；**「The album peaked at No. 1 on Billboard's Contemporary Jazz Albums chart」**；**入圍葛萊美 Best Jazz Vocal Performance, Male**；Rawls 以歐洲各大爵士節巡演推這張。製作段落：**「Rawls recorded his vocals live in the studio with his rhythm section」**、Lyle Lovett 與 Billy Vera 都在作曲者之列；**〈That's Where It's At〉是與 Ray Charles 的對唱**（原曲是 Sam Cooke 的，Rawls 當年就在原版上唱和聲）、**〈Fine Brown Frame〉是與 Dianne Reeves 的對唱**（Nellie Lutcher 的曲子）、〈Two Years of Torture〉是 Percy Mayfield 寫的。紐約時報 1989-07-07 評：「the album's songs, Mr. Rawls's rich drawling delivery and production that adds discreet pop flavoring to ensemble jazz arrangements all work together to bring jazz, blues and soul inflections into a perfectly relaxed and natural blend.」AllMusic（Ron Wynn）只給 2.5／5。

**Billboard 1989 年 6 月 24 日 p.8 的整版廣告**（本層新找到的一則，策展層沒有）：「one of the warmest and most distinctive voices of our time／**AT LAST**／LOU RAWLS brings the soul and blues tradition on home on Blue Note／Featuring: '**At Last**' '**You Can't Go Home**'／With very special guests: **DIANNE REEVES／RAY CHARLES／GEORGE BENSON／STANLEY TURRENTINE**」，下半版印「LOU RAWLS AT LAST TOUR」的行程：June 19–July 1 東京、New York City、Nice、Montreux、The Hague、London、Oakland……一路排到 11 月。**這一版把主打曲、四位客席與巡演檔期一次印齊，是本張最硬的一條同期紙本（第 612 條的廠牌檔期廣告）。**

**Billboard 1989 年 7 月 8 日 p.94 的評介**：「JAZZ／LOU RAWLS **At Last**／**PRODUCERS: Michael Cuscuna & Billy Vera**／Blue Note 91937／Superfine cross-genre work reacquaints us with the magnificent pipes of the Chi-town soul brother. Rawls' voice is still uncut velvet, and he unleashes it on standards and contemporary material (by Vera...)」。**同一週的 Cash Box 1989-07-08 p.22 JAZZ PICKS**：「LOU RAWLS: At Last (Blue Note 91937) That familiar bedroom bass-baritone in a recently-unfamiliar setting: low-down jazz/blues, with a classic-R&B edge. Mix of oldies and appropriate newies (**some penned by co-producer Billy Vera**). **Guests include Ray Charles and Dianne Reeves**, but the blue-chip backing band makes thi[s]...」——**兩刊同一週、各自獨立。**

Cash Box 1989 年 7 月 8 日 p.22 的 JAZZ PICKS 原文（與上一條互為獨立來源，出處不同刊）：「LOU RAWLS: At Last (Blue Note 91937) That familiar bedroom bass-baritone in a recently-unfamiliar setting: low-down jazz/blues, with a classic-R&B edge.」同頁另有 Pat Metheny《Letter From Home》的評介與當週爵士榜。

維基專頁 infobox 與曲目表：released 1989、**recorded January 30–31, 1989**、studio Rudy Van Gelder Studio, Englewood Cliffs, NJ、length **48:43**、label Blue Note、**producer Michael Cuscuna**。**逐軌錄音日**：「Recorded at Rudy Van Gelder Studio ... on **January 30 (tracks 4 & 6–9)** and **January 31 (tracks 1–3 & 5)**, 1989」——**〈Tail Feather〉〈Bobby's Tune〉與三首 alternate take 是 1 月 30 日錄的，〈Pinnacle〉〈Golden Sunset〉〈Samba Rasta〉〈Spiritual Lover〉是 1 月 31 日**。曲目表明寫三首 alternate take 是「Bonus track on CD」。六首主曲全是 Hill 自己寫的。AllMusic 的 Scott Yanow 給 4.5／5：「There are no weak performances on this superb post bop effort, **Andrew Hill's strongest recording in several years**」。

**Cash Box 1989 年 10 月 21 日 p.14 的 JAZZ PICKS**（全文）：「ANDREW HILL: Eternal Spirit (Blue Note 92051) **The pianist/composer responsible for some of the best Blue Note albums of the '60s is back with one of the best Blue Note albums of the '80s.** Hill's knotty compositions, and original, spare pianistics, are perfectly served by Bobby Hutcherson, Rufus Reid, Ben Riley and, **in his best outing on album to date, Greg Osby**. Off-center hard bop; **one of the year's best releases**.」同頁下方緊接著 Michel Petrucciani 那一則（＝本組《Music》）。

**兩份年度榜都收了它**：**Billboard 1989 年 12 月 23 日 p.203 的年度爵士回顧**把「**Andrew Hill, 'Eternal Spirit' (Blue Note)**」與 Jali Musa Jawara、John Carter、Alvin Batiste、Paul Motian、Steve Reich、Helen Merrill + Ron Carter、Miles Davis《Aura》、Etta James 並列；**Cash Box 1989 年 12 月 30 日 p.7 的「Top Ten Jazz Albums of 1989」（Lee Jeske 選，依藝人字母排）**同樣列「**Andrew Hill: Eternal Spirit; Blue Note**」，並與本批的 Don Pullen《New Beginnings》、Ralph Peterson《V》同列。

Cash Box 1989-12-30 p.7 的年度榜原文（與上一條不同刊、不同人選的獨立一則）：「Lee Jeske, New York Editor — Top Ten Jazz Albums of 1989 (alphabetically by artist)：Alvin Batiste: Bayou Magic; India Navigation／Miles Davis: Aura; Columbia／Dirty Dozen Brass Band: Voodoo; Columbia／**Andrew Hill: Eternal Spirit; Blue Note**／Branford Marsalis: Trio Jeepy; Columbia／Helen Merrill/Ron Carter: Duets; EmArcy／Frank Morgan: Mood Indigo; Antilles／Houston Person: Basics; Muse／Ralph Peterson: V; Blue Note／Don Pullen: New Beginnings; Blue Note」。

sound: 原盤黑膠六軌、CD 九軌（多三首 alternate take）的後咆勃。鋼琴＋中音薩克斯風＋顫音琴＋貝斯＋鼓的五重奏，六首主曲全是 Hill 自己寫的。〈Pinnacle〉與〈Golden Sunset〉各近十分鐘，是全盤最長的兩首，Hill 的和聲走向繞著旋律外緣走、不照和弦進行落點；〈Samba Rasta〉不到五分鐘、節奏最直接；〈Bobby's Tune〉題給 Hutcherson，顫音琴與鋼琴在這首裡互相讓位。Osby 的中音線條短、切分多，與 1960 年代那批 Hill 盤上的薩克斯風聲音不同。

維基 Gil Mellé 條目：**「In the 1950s, Mellé created the cover art for albums by Miles Davis, Thelonious Monk, and Sonny Rollins」**、「Mellé led a number of sessions recorded for the Blue Note and Prestige labels **between 1952 and 1957**」、他也在第一屆 Newport Jazz Festival 帶團演出。專輯年表把《The Andromeda Strain》(Kapp, 1971) 與《**Mindscape** (Blue Note, **1989**)》連在一起列，**中間隔著《Waterbirds》(Nocturne, 1970) 之後的一段空白**——**1971 到 1989 之間他的名下沒有任何一張唱片。**

**Billboard 1989 年 7 月 1 日 p.54 的 Blue Note 五十週年整版廣告**是本張唯一的同期紙本：已發行欄逐張印出「LOU RAWLS At Last／TONY WILLIAMS Angel Street／ELIANE ELIAS So Far So Close／DON PULLEN New Beginnings／**GIL MELLE Mindscape**／FREDDIE HUBBARD Times Are Changing／McCOY TYNER Revelations／George Adams Nightingale／Tommy Smith Step By Step／Jack Walrath Neohippus／Superblue Superblue」；藝人名單那一欄也有「Gil Melle」（**廣告把 é 印成 e**）。⚠ **本層把 Billboard 與 Cash Box 的 1988–89 兩份與 1990 全年四份 OCR 全掃過，「Mindscape」與 92168／91968 三個關鍵字只有這一處命中——沒有新片欄、沒有評介、沒有榜位。本組紙本最薄的一張。**

**Cash Box 1989 年 9 月 2 日 p.13 的 JAZZ PICKS**（全文）：「RICK MARGITZA: Color (Blue Note 7 92279) **Muscular debut from a Coltranesque tenor and sopranoist with a finely-tuned hard bop sense, although this album alternates the strong post-bop stuff with some watery sax-and-synth doodles.** Good sidemen (including Marc Johnson and Adam Nussbaum) and everybody swings. **Look for Margitza in Miles Davis' band.**」——**同期樂評自己就把「硬咆勃」與「薩克斯風加合成器的稀薄段落」兩面都寫出來了，正文寫評價可直接兩面並陳。**

**Billboard 1989 年 9 月 16 日 p.84 的評介**：「RICK MARGITZA Color／**PRODUCERS: Matt Pierson & Rick Margitza**／Blue Note 92279／Tenor man's debut is notable for leader's striking style — **a cool, thoughtful approach that is as light as any work on the instrument this side of Lester Young.** Very pleasant and ultrarelaxed outing, which numbers bassist Marc Johnson and percussionist Airto Moreira among the sidemen...」。**同一期 p.82 另有 Blue Note 的整版廣告**：「The tenor saxophone is the voice of jazz, dominated by a handful of innovators who have graced the music over the past 60 years. It is rare to find an artist whose concepts and style are all his own. **RICK MARGITZA is such a find. Ask Miles Davis, who invited Rick to join his band on the evidence of one cassette**, or hear it for yourself on his Blue Note debut, **COLOR**.」，並引 **Miles Davis「A great tenor player.」與 Michael Brecker「A truly gifted player.」兩句背書**。

**榜位（本層把 Cash Box 那一段補齊，策展層只有 1990-04-21 一週）**：Cash Box 的爵士榜 **1989-12-02 p.12 以 DEBUT 在第 20 名進榜**（印「COLOR (Blue Note **92779**) Rick Margitza」，**紙本誤植目錄號，正確 92279**，第 509c 條）、**1989-12-30 p.19 第 12 名（在榜 5 週）**、1990-04-21 仍在榜。Billboard 的 **TOP JAZZ ALBUMS** 則是 1989-11-25 以 NEW 在第 15 名進榜、1990-01-06 第 9 名（7 週）、1990-01-20 第 14 名（9 週）。⚠ **第 879 條**：本張上的是 **Jazz 榜不是 Contemporary Jazz 榜**。
